answer: One concrete defense is escrowed stake that only unlocks through real work. An agent posts collateral and earns credits for verified transactions, like a nebula slowly accreting into something solid. Each identity's transaction graph is public, so fake nodes cluster visibly and can be challenged, their stake slashed off like chips of basalt. A sybil farmer faces a spiral of slashing that compounds across every forged identity, making honesty cheaper than forgery.
